# Keyboard shortcuts

The editor's shortcuts, read from its real actions (as **Help › Keyboard shortcuts** does, which can also search them). **Ctrl+K** opens the command palette with every action, with or without a shortcut.

## Editor

| Shortcut | Command |
|---|---|
| ++ctrl+alt+0++ | Actual size |
| ++ctrl+shift+p++ | Add page |
| ++ctrl+return++ | Apply script |
| ++ctrl+k++ | Command palette… |
| ++f8++ | Continue |
| ++ctrl+alt+c++ | Copy style |
| ++f6++ | Cycle focus region |
| ++f9++ | Debug application |
| ++ctrl+2++ | Design mode |
| ++ctrl+d++ | Duplicate |
| ++ctrl+shift+e++ | Export application… |
| ++ctrl+0++ | Fit composition |
| ++f1++ | Getting started |
| ++ctrl+alt+b++ | Inspector |
| ++ctrl+b++ | Left panel |
| ++ctrl+3++ | Logic mode |
| ++ctrl+1++ | Map mode |
| ++alt+down++ | Move after |
| ++alt+up++ | Move before |
| ++ctrl+n++ | New project |
| ++f10++ | Next step |
| ++ctrl+o++ | Open… |
| ++ctrl+j++ | Output and problems |
| ++ctrl+alt+v++ | Paste style |
| ++ctrl+comma++ | Preferences… |
| ++ctrl+shift+z++, ++ctrl+y++ | Redo |
| ++f2++ | Rename selection |
| ++ctrl+s++ | Save |
| ++ctrl+shift+s++ | Save as… |
| ++ctrl+shift+f++ | Search in project… |
| ++f11++ | Step into function |
| ++shift+f11++ | Step out of function |
| ++shift+f5++ | Stop test |
| ++f5++ | Test application |
| ++ctrl+z++ | Undo |

## Code editor

| Shortcut | Command |
|---|---|
| ++ctrl+space++ | Suggestions |
| ++ctrl+shift+space++ | Parameters of the call |
| ++f12++ | Go to definition |
| ++f2++ | Rename in this file |
| ++ctrl+f++ | Find |
| ++ctrl+h++ | Replace |
| ++f3++, ++shift+f3++ | Next and previous match |
| ++ctrl+g++ | Go to line |
| ++escape++ | Close the find bar |
| ++f4++ | In View Python: go to the block of this line |

## Exported apps

In Qt apps, ++f11++ toggles full screen. The shortcuts of the menus you create (after `|` on each item) work in the exported app.
